Attached: 1 video

New model generation. Do you wipe your skills files or refactor them?

DJ Sampath (Cisco) says wipe them: you built them for a model that needed help. I think you reassess every generation, but refactor rather than throw them out wholesale.

DJ's example: "here's my personal PR bot. I'm gonna call it Jarvis. I think that's our problem right there."

https://chainofthought.show/podcast/80-how-cisco-secures-personal-ai-assistants-for-90-000-employees-dj-sampath/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ep80
